units.source_text: 葵姬对于源氏公子的轻薄行径，当然很不满意。

en.t: Lady Aoi was naturally very displeased with Prince Genji's frivolous behavior.

units.source_text: 然而，想是她认为过于激烈反对无补于事吧，并不十分妒恨。

en.t: However, perhaps she felt that opposing him too fiercely would do no good, and so she was not especially jealous or resentful.

units.source_text: 此时她已怀孕，精神不愉快，心中闷闷不乐。

en.t: By this time she was already pregnant, and her spirits were low; she felt gloomy and unhappy at heart.

units.source_text: 源氏公子闻知她已怀孕，深感庆幸，父母亲等亦皆大欢喜。

en.t: When Prince Genji heard that she was pregnant, he felt deeply grateful and relieved, and his parents and the others were all overjoyed as well.

units.source_text: 然亦不免担心，便举行种种佛事，祈求安产。

en.t: Even so, they could not help worrying, and so they held various Buddhist rites to pray for a safe delivery.

units.source_text: 这期间源氏公子自然增添忙碌，对六条妃子等情人虽然并不忘怀，然而足迹渐稀了。

en.t: During this time Prince Genji naturally became busier; although he did not forget lovers such as the Rokujo lady, his visits to them gradually became less frequent.
